rows.title: Native shell and one-window lifetime
rows.baseline_behavior: Sidebar, common top bar, transcript, composer, status bar, contextual panes; initial window maximized with display-relative restore bounds and minimum 960×640. macOS Dock reopen reuses the same OrbitApp.
rows.baseline_edge_state: App-owned heartbeat survives window closure: 16 ms active, 90 ms idle. Closing a window must not silently kill a running session. Windows/Linux closure semantics remain platform-specific.
rows.fixture: Two temporary workspaces, an isolated HOME/PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, fixture session JSONL files and controllable Pi RPC children.

steps.action: Launch against displays 1280×800 and 1920×1080 and a no-display-metadata fixture; inspect initial window options, then unmaximize.
steps.expected: Initially maximized and focused, minimum960×640. Restore bounds are min(displayWidth×0.85,1440) by min(displayHeight×0.9,920), centered; no-display fallback1240×840. Composer is focused and app id is dev.orbit.pi.

steps.action: Verify same session and process identity after reopening; test a window smaller than the source minimum.
steps.expected: App-owned heartbeat survives window closure: 16 ms active, 90 ms idle. Closing a window must not silently kill a running session. Windows/Linux closure semantics remain platform-specific.

steps.action: Inject failure from the native open_window adapter, then retry opening without creating another app controller.
steps.expected: The source logs 'Orbit: could not open the main window' and returns; no success window handle, duplicate OrbitApp or duplicate heartbeat is created.

steps.action: Start a fixture streaming Pi session, close all windows, advance the heartbeat, finish the session and reopen.
steps.expected: The app-owned heartbeat still drains while windowless:90ms idle and16ms active after each observed tick; repaint is unnecessary without a window. This is not a window-loading spinner.

steps.action: Record OrbitApp identity and child PID; close the macOS window without quitting; reopen from Dock and compare.
steps.expected: The same global shell entity and existing Pi child are reused. This gate concerns in-process retention, not disk session restoration after full app exit.

steps.action: Use native window close and the macOS application reopen event; inspect app command bindings for a dedicated resize/reopen action.
steps.expected: No app-specific resize or reopen keyboard chord is invented. Composer focus is restored by open(); normal OS window controls retain their native behavior.

steps.action: Close and reopen the main window three times while a controlled Pi child emits numbered events.
steps.expected: One retained controller and child, one heartbeat; every event is reduced once and returning window shows the current session. Actual macOS Dock behavior remains a native-OS gate.

rows.title: Resizable workbench geometry
rows.baseline_behavior: Drag sidebar, Review sidepane, Explorer and terminal splitters; clamp minimums and reserve readable main content; full-width Review is separate from width resize.
rows.baseline_edge_state: Four sizes in ~/.orbit-pi/layout.json; writes settle after 500 ms. Invalid/nonfinite/out-of-range stored sizes discarded. Open/closed surfaces are not all persisted in this store.
rows.fixture: Two temporary workspaces, an isolated HOME/PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, fixture session JSONL files and controllable Pi RPC children.

steps.action: Drag Sidebar, Review, Explorer and Terminal below minimum, to a normal size and above maximum; toggle full-width Review independently.
steps.expected: Sidebar default248/min200; Review default460/min300/drag max900; Explorer default248/min172/max460; Terminal default260/min96. Main content retains480px reserve where the source resize handler applies it. Full-width Review preserves its separate restore width.

steps.action: Persist a valid size, then supply negative, huge and nonfinite saved values in a copied home; relaunch.
steps.expected: Four sizes in ~/.orbit-pi/layout.json; writes settle after 500 ms. Invalid/nonfinite/out-of-range stored sizes discarded. Open/closed surfaces are not all persisted in this store.

steps.action: Make the fixture ~/.orbit-pi/layout.json parent unwritable; drag and allow the settle flush. Restore permission, change a size again and flush.
steps.expected: Pinned Layout.persist ignores write errors: current live size remains, old disk state is not falsely claimed updated, and a later changed size can persist. This action has no session-scan or Pi dependency.

steps.action: Record a size change at t=0; flush at499ms and500ms. Record an identical value at400ms and repeat.
steps.expected: No disk write before500ms; one flush when changed value has settled. Recording the same value does not rearm the timer. Resizing is immediate and has no loading spinner.

steps.action: Persist sidebar_width248, sidepane_width460, explorer_width300, terminal_height260 in ~/.orbit-pi/layout.json; relaunch. Repeat with missing, text,10,99999 and nonfinite parsed fields.
steps.expected: Only those four sizes belong to this store. Numeric finite values in inclusive80…4000 survive parsing before panel-specific clamps; invalid fields become absent/default independently. Malformed file defaults all fields. Open panels, fonts and theme are not restored by this file.

steps.action: After resizing use Cmd+B/Ctrl+B, Cmd+Shift+E/Ctrl+Shift+E and Cmd+J/Ctrl+J to toggle Sidebar, Explorer and Terminal; reopen each.
steps.expected: The registered source panel actions toggle visibility without treating those keys as resize commands; remembered size is retained. Review ToggleSidePanel has no chord in this command entry, so no invented key is required.

steps.action: Perform100 pointer size updates, stop, then leave the splitter stationary and reopen the panel three times.
steps.expected: Live geometry updates without writing per pixel; one settled write per changed burst. Stationary input does not repeatedly rewrite layout.json; visibility toggles retain size.

rows.baseline_behavior: Command palette, native menu, shortcuts help and pointer controls dispatch the same action identities; labels use Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere.
rows.baseline_edge_state: Context-specific bindings override global behavior. Access/workflow/MCP and worktrees commands include palette-only entries without fabricated chords.

steps.expected: Command palette, native menu, shortcuts help and pointer controls dispatch the same action identities; labels use Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere.

steps.action: Repeat each chord from composer, editor, terminal and dialog focus; verify out-of-context actions are not dispatched.
